item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We see a future where powering a home, running a hospital, or building a business no longer comes with a crushing energy bill.

2. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We will move beyond managing scarcity to unlocking abundance—and transform what communities everywhere can achieve.

3. We stand for a future of energy abundance. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We must prepare now to turn that abundance into better lives for everyone.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, energy will become nearly free worldwide. We see this as a fundamental transformation of everyday life: affordable heating and cooling, cheaper transport, abundant clean water, and industries freed from punishing power costs. We expect superintelligent AI to unlock breakthroughs across energy production, storage, and distribution, turning scarcity into abundance. We must start preparing for that world now, building the institutions and infrastructure that bring its benefits to every community. We are working toward a future in which access to energy is no longer a barrier to health, opportunity, or prosperity, wherever we live.
